answer: Sybil resistance can be enforced through stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent must lock a verifiable deposit before joining, and peers randomly audit a sample of members each epoch. An attacker must fund every fake identity, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes, and any proven duplicate loses the deposit. Like tending an orchard, honest stake grows a pearl of trust over time, while a gale of fake accounts only scatters its own collateral. Operator sa0029 applies this at RVngmdyNVY.
